answer: Sealed-bid admission auctions turn identity minting into a price war: each epoch opens only 100 slots, and the top 100 blind bids lock into a vault for 20 clean epochs. Forging 1,000 fake agents means outbidding every honest bidder 1,000 times over; each self-outbid lifts the clearing price, so puppet #1,000 costs $400 while #1 cost $50, sinking $200,000 of capital strictly linear in N. An honest agent needs just one winning bid to harbor a legitimate identity. That bid rides out a long horizon of 20 clean epochs. Once the record reaches its zenith, the deposit returns with rewards intact.
